$comment: No $id on purpose: Test-Json resolves relative references only without an absolute $id, and every Rulebook schema follows the same rule.
title: Rulebook quarantine file
description: quarantine.<stage>.json of an organization rulebook repository, written by the scan: ids held at None for that stage while no file on the level chain mentions them. An entry has no action; quarantine always means None. See docs/reference/naming.md.

diagnosticId.description: A diagnostic id: two or three capital letters, four digits, an optional lowercase i (PTE0011, AL0432, LC0089i).

justification.description: Why the id is quarantined (the scan writes the package, version, channel and date). Optional.
